description: This Java source file defines an abstract base class named EntityOperation for entity-related operations in the Apache OFBiz framework's mini-language. It includes constructor logic for initializing with XML element attributes and a method to retrieve the appropriate Delegator instance based on the context.

classes.name: EntityOperation
classes.description: An abstract class serving as the base for all entity operations within the mini-language framework, encapsulating logic to retrieve a Delegator object based on configuration and context.

methods.name: EntityOperation
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the EntityOperation with an XML element and a SimpleMethod instance, extracting a 'delegator-name' attribute as a FlexibleStringExpander.

methods.name: getDelegator
methods.description: Retrieve the appropriate Delegator instance based on the environment map; defaults to the Delegator associated with the current method context if no specific delegator name is configured.
